title: The source-library conditional ambient exceptional adjoint
statement: Let A be a Grothendieck abelian coefficient category with Hom universe u+1, X,Y schemes in universe u, and f:X→Y a morphism with a chosen compactification X --j→ Z --p→ Y. Suppose the exact source-library predicate HasAmbientExceptionalRightAdjoint A f holds: there is c≥0 such that for every V in Y.ProEt and every pullback p prime:X prime→V of p, the degree-r homology of Rp prime_*(F[0]) vanishes for every A-valued pro-etale sheaf F on X prime and every integer r>c. Then the exact source-library functor Rf_! = D(j_!) ⋙ Rp_* is a left adjoint on the ordinary unbounded derived categories of A-valued pro-etale sheaves. This proves existence for the chosen compactification and does not assert the additional finite-coefficient refinement coherence of lem-sp-fullcd-ambient-adjoint.

proof.text: Apply the uniform bound only to the identity object of Y.ProEt and the identity horizontal pullback. The source-library comparison isZero_rightDerived_of_isZero_homology converts it to the classical finite bound R^qp_*(F)=0 for q>c.

Properness of p implies quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness. The Grothendieck-coefficient pro-etale coproduct/acyclicity theorem gives preservation by p_* and acyclicity of all sums of injectives. The finite-dimensional derived criterion now gives preservation of coproducts by Rp_*.

Supply coproducts in both unbounded derived categories using derived_hasCoproducts. The derived direct image is triangulated and commutes with shifts. Apply Grothendieck-derived Brown representability to obtain that Rp_* is a left adjoint.

The open extension functor j_! has its existing derived adjunction to open restriction. Thus D(j_!) is a left adjoint. The definition of Rf_! is the composite D(j_!) ⋙ Rp_*, and the composite of left adjoints is a left adjoint.
